notes:
Specifically refers to physical growth and development of the body, especially of children, infants, and organisms. Composed of ⟦{発|はつ}→〜発：04026_hatsu⟧ (emit, develop) and {育|いく} (grow, raise). Primarily used in medical, childcare, and biological contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {発育|はついく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧/⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: good/poor development
- {発育|はついく}⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧: growth condition
- {発育|はついく}⟦{不良|ふりょう}→不良：11320_furyou⟧: poor growth, failure to thrive
- {発育|はついく}⟦{段階|だんかい}→段階：04515_dankai⟧: stage of development

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧: growth — broader; includes physical, mental, and figurative growth
- ⟦{発達|はったつ}→発達：03559_hattatsu⟧: development — emphasizes functional and mental development
- ⟦{生育|せいいく}→生育：22487_seiiku⟧: growth — used for plants and organisms in natural environments
